title: Split the checks job by family, and rebalance the macOS guard shards
why: Retrospective CI audit 14:12 CST Nov 12, batch 103 green run 43234925158: 55.0 min wall; checks is 35.1 min over 161 serial steps with no single suite dominating; macOS guard shard 1/2 alone takes 19.1 min.
note: R55 express (owner 14:05 CST Nov 12). Split checks by family, as the Windows split does; rebalance the macOS guard shards. Estimate: the run ends near 30 min (unmeasured). Side notes from the audit: impeccable-sync.yml:12 has top-level contents: write; playwright-setup steps at checks.yml:732, 768, 804, 844 have no cap of their own; no setup-python or npm cache (0.5-1.1 min per job).
